title: Amazing tour
text: This tour is very educational and amazing of history, our tour guide was knowledgeable and he teaches future tour guides we were very lucky to have him, if you don’t mind spending the few extra dollars it’s worth the price make sure you book in advance because they only allow so many people a day in. The only thing is if your coming in on a cruise you will have to get a driver due to the tour is 1hr 40 minute ride each way and it cost $350 round trip our driver was excellent and if you don’t speak the language make sure you have google translate live conversation it works very good
author: Dennis_L

title: Great tour for the historically and intellectually curious!
text: This tour was very nice and we gor a lot of detail throughout the palace and gardens from our guide Abubakr, who was excellent. From religious explanations and historical facts to stories of Life in the 13th century when the Alhambra construction was started, through to the 19th century. I had not realized that the reason the Alhambra stands today is primarily due to Washington Irving, who was an ambassador to Spain! I highly recommend this tour to the intellectually and historically curious!
author: Bob_F

title: Alhambra tour
text: Our guide Anis was excellent. He gave us a great understanding of the architecture. His knowledge of the history was exceptional. We enjoyed spending our day with him learning about the culture and history of the Alhambra. I highly recommend this tour.
author: Gail_G

title: Exploring this City and learning its history with Isabel
text: Isabel was outstanding. She was knowledgeable and enthusiastically shared her knowledge with us. She was personable. Answered all our questions. We felt Isabel was essential to our understanding and enjoyment of the spectacular Alhambra. I highly recommend taking a tour with her.
author: Ira_G

title: Stunning
text: This place is in my opinion in the league of the Taj Mahal. Petra and the Pyramids. It was beautiful, we were not rushed and the whole experience was amazing, We spent around 6 hours but could have stayed longer. Granada was also very nice and easy to go around, safe and reasonably priced eateries
author: 353ebrahimp

title: Excellent guide -your own...
text: Excellent guide -your own personal historian. Much more expensive than a big tour group with crappy headphones. Far more personal.
author: Laurence_G

title: Wonderful Alhambra experience
text: We had a wonderful trip to the Alhambra. Our guide Abubakr was extremely enthusiastic &  knowledgeable of the Alhambra and he brought the history of the palace to life. The visit flew past listening to Abubakr. We would definitely recommend Abubakr as a guide and our private tour was  worth the ticket price.
author: normagI2550SG

title: Loved it
text: I loved having my personal tour guide who did a great job at blending conversation and information. He explained the history as well as the architecture in a way that I could understand.
author: Jason_C

title: Very Informative Tour Guide — A+
text:
He reached out the day before and twice the morning of the tour. It was so easy meeting up with him for the tour. 
He was very informative and knew his history of the Alhambra. We listened to every word he said. Highly recommend our tour guide. We give him a A+
author: Jonathan_A

title: Absolutely Wonderful!
text: We had the pleasure of having Abubakr as our tour guide and it was nothing short of amazing. I know that 3 hours might sound intimidating and like something you might check out of halfway through, but Abubakr was so fun and really told a story as you walked through the Alhambra. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone wanting a fun and fascinating tour. We learned so much that we could’ve never discovered in our own. For reference it was my husband and I and our two daughters. What a blast.
author: Sydney_S
